client.description: The run, else the hooks, else the transcript.

session.description: The session as lists show it; model and title filled from the transcript when missing.

SessionDto.description: A Claude Code session as its hooks reported it.

label.description: Name to show, such as `SE-001: Fix the login`; may be empty.

listening.description: Idle, running or waiting and not stale.

number.description: Per repository, once the repository is known.

repositoryId.description: Repository whose checkout holds the cwd; null outside every known checkout.

runName.description: Run that started the session, for NULLRADIX sessions.

SetBoardRepository.description: Points a board to the repository checked out at a folder on a runner.

path.description: Absolute folder on the runner; any folder inside the checkout or a worktree of it.

version.description: Version the change is based on.

template.description: The own template; blank goes back to the default.

version.description: Version of the dispatcher configuration the change is based on.

SetRunToken.description: The long-lived token of `claude setup-token`; it is only ever sent, never returned.

version.description: Version the change is based on.

SimilarNoteDto.description: A note the similarity check found.

ticketKey.description: Key of the ticket it was promoted to.

StartDispatchRunBody.description: A Claude run to start from the dispatcher configuration; the scheduler uses the same use case.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory on the daemon's machine.

profile.description: A profile by name; none takes the one of the kind, else the default.

subjectKey.description: Ticket key, or question key for research runs.

email.description: Filled into the login page of the browser.

StartRun.description: A command to run on the daemon's machine; only token holders may start runs.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory on the daemon's machine.

StartTicket.description: Starts a ticket from a folder on a runner; `joinTicket` and `join` exclude each other.

cwd.description: Absolute folder in the board's repository; without a target the branch starts at its HEAD.

force.description: Lifts the dependency and question locks.

join.description: Joins the first open worktree with the same target, else creates one.

joinTicket.description: Joins this ticket's worktree; a different target gives a warning and an own worktree.

cleanup.description: Ready worktrees removed or kept before the start.

joined.description: The ticket joined an existing worktree.

oneOf.description: A missing target branch the start created.

worktree.description: Folder of the worktree on the runner, with forward slashes.

StepDto.description: A work step; numbers count from 1.

StreamPosition.description: Data of the `ready` and `reset` events: the position the stream continues from.

from.description: Such as `origin/release`, or the branch or commit of the main checkout.

claudeTheme.description: Whether the package brings a theme for Claude Code.

network.description: Domains the theme may load from.

packageVersion.description: Version of the theme itself, a semver version.

sdkVersion.description: Range of SDK versions the theme runs with.

styleUrl.description: URL of the stylesheet the UI links while the theme is chosen.

active.description: The chosen theme: `nullradix`, `system`, `light`, `dark` or an installed id.

ThemeSettingValueDto.description: A switch or the value of one option.

ThemeSettingsDto.description: The values chosen for the settings of a theme.

values.description: Chosen values by setting key; a key without a value uses the default of the manifest.

version.description: Row version for saving and resetting; 0 while nothing was saved.

TicketDto.description: A ticket as boards show it; timestamps are Unix milliseconds.

branch.description: Branch of the worktree the ticket works in right now.

openQuestions.description: Open questions about the ticket; they hold it back from in progress and done.

planningClaimBy.description: Who plans the ticket now; a claim lives 15 minutes.

targetBranch.description: Branch the ticket merges into; none means the default branch.

unlocks.description: Dependents that become ready once this ticket is done.

waiting.description: Ahead of the work with an open dependency.

worktree.description: Folder of that worktree on its runner.

TicketReadinessDto.description: A planned ticket and why the dispatcher does or does not take it.

TimeWindowDto.description: Local time window in which new runs may start; `to` before `from` wraps past midnight.

ToolResultDto.description: Output of a tool call, cut to 20000 characters.

finished.description: The run ended and no output is left.

lastSeq.description: The last output line read; ask for lines after it.

more.description: The read stopped at its limit; ask again at once.

oneOf.description: A tool call with its summary, input and result once there.

input.description: The tool input as Claude Code sent it.

oneOf.description: A note of the system such as a hook error or compaction.

TranscriptEntryDto.description: One transcript entry; a later page repeating an id replaces the entry.

available.description: Whether the runner could read the transcript the hooks named.

TranscriptLineDto.description: One readable line of the run log.

detail.description: The exact call or the whole message when the text is cut.

reference.description: Id of the tool call, on a call and on its result.

seq.description: The output line it came from.

cursor.description: Byte offset for `after` of the next page.

UpdateAccount.description: A change of fields; left out fields stay, `null` removes a limit.

version.description: Version the change is based on; a newer stored version fails with `version-conflict`.

content.description: Replaces the content; left out keeps it.

enabled.description: Switches the customization on or off; left out keeps it.

version.description: Version the change is based on; a newer stored version fails with `version-conflict`.

enabled.description: Start new tickets, or not, whatever the configuration says.

version.description: Version the change is based on; a newer stored version fails with `version-conflict`.

UpdateTicket.description: A change of fields; left out fields stay, `null` clears those that may be empty.

boardId.description: Moves the ticket to another board of its project.

branch.description: Only null, which clears both branch and worktree; a value is refused.

dependsOn.description: Replaces the dependencies and then ignores the add list; the remove list applies last.

force.description: Lifts the dependency, question and not-needed locks.

version.description: Version the change is based on.

worktree.description: Only null, which clears both branch and worktree; a value is refused.

UsageDto.description: The limits of the subscription behind an account; without numbers `reason` says why.

fetchedAt.description: When the numbers were read, in Unix milliseconds.

UsageWindowDto.description: How much of a limit window is used.

resetsAt.description: When the window starts over, in Unix milliseconds.

WaitingDto.description: A dependency that is still open, with its question state or ticket status.

WorktreeSetupStepDto.description: Command run in a fresh worktree before Claude starts.

cwd.description: Folder relative to the worktree root; `.` is the root itself.

WritePlan.description: A plan; at least one of plan, handbook and diagram.

diagram.description: Mermaid; a Markdown fence around it is dropped.
